caveats: Officer Christine Silk sued LMPD/Louisville Metro (filed June 18, 2024) over sexual harassment by training officers Justin LeMon and Dale Cottongim. WDRB (Dec 2025) reports a $200,000 settlement; Silk resigned from LMPD. LeMon was fired for conduct unbecoming (harassment/sexual abuse allegations 'not sustained'); Cottongim reprimanded/transferred and exonerated on the harassment allegation. No criminal charges mentioned in any source. One source (whas11.com) timed out and was skipped.
